review.note: Sieving skyblock engine (Verdant's ore source). Barrels, sieves, crucibles in every wood type, hammers and meshes are the core loop. Ore chunks come from sieving, so they need no ore in the world. Built-in support: AE2 (recipes), Ars Nouveau (archwood variants), plus JEI/EMI/Jade/KubeJS.
